subject: Post-call: next steps after meeting URL rotated — availability for technical deep dive
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lindsey Park <lindsey.park@finovo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: next steps after meeting URL rotated — availability for technical deep dive

Hi Lindsey — thanks again for the quick discovery call this morning. I’m sorry about the join link confusion — looks like our meeting URL rotated at the last minute and the calendar event you received pointed to the old bridge. We’ve corrected the event on our side and I’m attaching a fresh calendar file (finovo-tech-deepdive.ics) that should map cleanly into your calendar.

Quick recap of what we discussed:
- Main goals: lower latency for inference pipelines, predictable per-token costs, and tighter operational observability for the QA team.
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent PHI workflows on a private VPC; preference for dedicated capacity during peak inference windows.
- Decision-makers likely: you + CTO (Tariq) for architecture signoff; procurement (copy to sales alias) for T&Cs.

Next step: technical deep dive with an engineer and solution architect to validate integration pattern and perf targets. Can you confirm a 60–75 minute slot next week? I can offer these windows (all PST):
- Tue 2026-12-15 09:00–10:15
- Wed 2026-12-16 13:00–14:15
- Thu 2026-12-17 08:30–09:45

If none of those work, tell me two good windows and Ben will lock the invite. I’ve attached a short SOW draft so your procurement team can eyeball scope/terms early (Redwood-Finovo-SOW-draft.pdf).

Also — if your team prefers a dial-in bridge instead of the meeting URL, we can provision that and include a secondary PSTN dial-in in the invite.

Thanks,
Mateo

--
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0126
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-Finovo-SOW-draft.pdf (PDF, 38KB), finovo-tech-deepdive.ics (calendar invite stub)

Hi Mateo — thanks for the recap and for re-issuing the calendar file. We never got the correct join link earlier, so that explains the scramble on our side.

A few quick notes:
- Our team is US Central (CST) — just flagging that so the invite maps correctly for Tariq and the infra folks.
- The procurement and security reviewers will want to see the SOW and a short note on data handling (where logs are retained / ability to bring-your-own-key). I’ll forward the SOW to them.

For slots, the Wed 12/16 13:00 PST works for me (that’s 15:00 CST) — I can get Tariq to join and will loop in our infra lead (Aisha) if we confirm. If you can send the invite with both the new meeting URL and a PSTN fallback, that’d be ideal.

Also: could you include a short recording or summary from today’s session? I missed the last 10 minutes.

Best,
Lindsey
Director of Platform Engineering | Finovo
lindsey.park@finovo.com | +1 (312) 555-0179
